peopleAlsoAsk.question: Does paramyxovirus cause croup?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: The most severe manifestation of infection with types 1 and 2 viruses is croup, whereas type 3 virus causes all three syndromes. Parainfluenza type 3 can also cause meningitis. Type 4 infections usually cause mild symptoms but cases with symptoms of bronchiolitis, pneumonia or aseptic meningitis have been reported.
